HACK IT ON’26 | 24-Hour Inter-College Hackathon

About the Hackathon

Get ready for  HACK IT ON’26 , an exciting  24-hour inter-college hackathon  where innovation meets teamwork!

Organized at the  Department of Information Technology, KPR Institute of Engineering and Technology (KPRIET), Coimbatore .

HACK IT ON’26 brings together passionate student innovators to build impactful solutions using emerging technologies.

With six exciting technology domains, participants will brainstorm, develop, and present innovative solutions while competing for prizes, internship opportunities, recognition, and valuable industry exposure.

REGISTER HERE : https://www.hackiton.in/26

__________________________________________________________________________________

 Event Details

   Hackathon Dates: 8th & 9th October 2026

   Mode: Offline

   Duration: 24 Hours Non-Stop

   Venue:  Department of Information Technology, KPR Institute of Engineering and Technology , Coimbatore

   Team Size: 2–4 Members

   Eligibility:  Open to External Participants

_________________________________________________________________________________

 Registration Fee

   Per Participant:

      IEEE Members:  ₹500
      Non-IEEE Members:  ₹600

 Registration Note:
      Only the **Team Leader** should complete the payment and registration process for the entire team .

_________________________________________________________________________________

 Prize Pool

    Big prize pool , along with exciting  internship opportunities  and recognition from industry experts.

_________________________________________________________________________________ 

 Hackathon Domains

     AI & Smart Solutions : Build intelligent solutions using Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, automation, and smart technologies to address real-world challenges.

    Cyber Defense & Digital Security : Develop innovative solutions focused on cybersecurity, digital safety, threat detection, privacy, and secure systems.

    Health & Wellness Tech : Create technology-driven solutions that improve healthcare, wellness, accessibility, and quality of life.

    Green & Sustainable Tech :Develop innovative solutions that promote sustainability, environmental protection, energy efficiency, and a greener future.

    Industry & Automation : Build practical solutions using automation, IoT, intelligent systems, and emerging technologies to improve industrial processes.

    Open Innovation & Future Technologies : Explore emerging technologies and create innovative solutions without being limited to a specific problem domain.

_________________________________________________________________________________

  Judging Criteria :

   Projects will be evaluated based on:

     Innovation & Creativity 
     Technical Implementation 
     Problem Solving & Impact 
     Feasibility & Scalability
     UI/UX Design
     Presentation & Communication Skills

  Participants should focus not only on building a functional prototype but also on demonstrating its  innovation, real-world impact, usability, and future potential 

_________________________________________________________________________________

 Rules & Guidelines

   All major project work, including  code, design, and development , must be carried out during the hackathon.
  Open-source tools, APIs, libraries, and development frameworks may be used with applicable attribution and licensing.
  Each team must maintain  one dedicated GitHub repository .
  Teams must be prepared to provide their project progress and commit history  if requested.
  Plagiarism, misconduct, intellectual-property violations, or unfair practices may result in immediate disqualification .
  The decision of the jury and organizing committee will be final and binding .

_________________________________________________________________________________ 

 Food & Refreshments

    Participants will be provided with food and refreshments throughout the event , allowing teams to focus on building and innovating during the 24-hour hackathon.

 _________________________________________________________________________________

 Why Participate ?

  Compete in a  24-hour inter-college hackathon 
  Explore AI, cybersecurity, healthcare, sustainability, automation, and future technologies
  Build and demonstrate a real-world solution
  Present your project to judges and industry experts
  Get opportunities for exciting internships 
  Network with mentors, students, and innovators
  Earn certificates and recognition
  Receive exclusive HACK IT ON’26 goodies
  Take part in 24 hours of non-stop innovation and collaboration 

_________________________________________________________________________________

Team Formation

 Team Size:  2–4 members
 Participants can form teams with students from different colleges, as this is an inter-college hackathon .
 The event is open to external participants .
 Only the Team Leader needs to complete the team's payment and registration process

_________________________________________________________________________________ 

 Build Through the Night. Innovate Beyond Limits.

 HACK IT ON’26

 Where Innovation Meets Teamwork.
